mapper.select: select id, training_time, model_version, epochs, batch_size, image_size, best_pt_path, last_pt_path, create_time from seer.annotations_training_tasks order by id
select id, training_time, model_version, epochs, batch_size, image_size, best_pt_path, last_pt_path, create_time from seer.annotations_training_tasks where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into seer.annotations_training_tasks (id, training_time, model_version, epochs, batch_size, image_size, best_pt_path, last_pt_path, create_time) values (#{id}, #{trainingTime}, #{modelVersion}, #{epochs}, #{batchSize}, #{imageSize}, #{bestPtPath}, #{lastPtPath}, now())
mapper.update: update seer.annotations_training_tasks set training_time = #{trainingTime}, model_version = #{modelVersion}, epochs = #{epochs}, batch_size = #{batchSize}, image_size = #{imageSize}, best_pt_path = #{bestPtPath}, last_pt_path = #{lastPtPath} where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into seer.annotations_training_tasks (id, model_version, epochs, batch_size, image_size) select distinct r.id, 'YOLOv8s', 300, 16, 640 from seer.annotations_epoch_results r where r.id is not null and r.id != ''
mapper.select: select id, epoch, `time`, train_box_loss, train_cls_loss, train_dfl_loss, metrics_precision_B, metrics_recall_B, metrics_mAP50_B, metrics_mAP50_95_B, val_box_loss, val_cls_loss, val_dfl_loss, lr_pg0, lr_pg1, lr_pg2 from seer.annotations_epoch_results where id = #{id} order by epoch
